title: Route Performance Mosaic: streaming vs non-streaming latency profiler
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a composite latency profiling dashboard and tracing instrumentation that slices p50/p95/p99 by model, route, and IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming). This ticket covers: adding rich span tags for model_version, route_id, io_mode, request_shape; emitting stabilized histogram metrics for token and response latencies; extending log/metric pipelines to carry route/model context into long-term storage; and a Grafana+Tempo dashboard layout that makes regressions and cross-model comparisons obvious. Goal is to reduce time-to-root-cause for route-level regressions and enable SRE/Platform to correlate tracing with aggregated SLI windows.

acceptance_criteria: Tracing: spans emitted with model.name, model.version, route.id, io.mode and request_shape.bucket for 95% of server paths
Metrics: histogram metric response_latency_ms.histogram exported to Prometheus with labels route_id, model_version, io_mode and request_shape
Dashboard: Grafana board with p50/p95/p99 rows, streaming vs non-streaming toggle, per-model comparative heatmap, and direct trace links to Tempo
Pipelines: logs and metrics retain model_version and route_id in long-term storage (BigQuery) for at least 30 days
Regression detection: automated alert rule that fires when p95 for any route increases by >=20% over baseline with an actionable runbook link
telemetry_changes: New span tags: model.name, model.version, route.id, io.mode, chunk_id, request_shape.bucket. New metrics: response_latency_ms.histogram (labels: route_id, model_version, io_mode, request_shape), response_latency_ms.p50, .p95, .p99 summaries. Export path: application -> Vector -> Prometheus remote_write / BigQuery. Traces -> Tempo with 7d retention for canary tenants.
rollout_plan: 1) Instrumentation merged to main and feature-flagged (two-week canary) 2) Deploy canary to a small subset of tenants in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 3) Monitor p50/p95/p99 deltas and trace sampling fidelity for 48h 4) Fix any deduplication or pipeline label stripping issues 5) Gradual rollout to all tenants over 72h 6) Promote Grafana dashboard to default console views
notes: Trade-offs: emitting histograms increases cardinality due to model_version/route labels; mitigations include label cardinality caps and aggregation by model_major_version. We prioritized tracing fidelity for streaming flows to speed RCT. Open questions: canonical request_shape bucketing strategy and retention policy for chunk-level traces.
